name: manual_c2479e
claim: Never assume macOS /usr/bin/openssl behaves like OpenSSL 3.x: Apple LibreSSL 3.3.6 rejects -no-CAstore as unknown option and ignores SSL_CERT_DIR for verify, requiring explicit platform limitation reporting rather than handwaving.

decisions.notes: Pack test specifications that prescribe OpenSSL 3.x CLI flags fail against macOS system LibreSSL 3.3.6 (exit 1 on -no-CAstore, exit 2 on verify). Without touching protected system trust stores, the control must be reported honestly as UNVERIFIED.

rationale: Pack test specifications that prescribe OpenSSL 3.x CLI flags fail against macOS system LibreSSL 3.3.6 (exit 1 on -no-CAstore, exit 2 on verify). Without touching protected system trust stores, the control must be reported honestly as UNVERIFIED.
